title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.23999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations

translated_title: ReliFlow：面向组合式单细胞扰动预测的可靠性校准残差传输方法
translated_abstract: 预测组合扰动的转录响应，需要将干预之间的相互作用与单扰动效应估计中的误差区分开来。当单扰动证据稀疏或被完全留出时，这类误差会变得更加显著。我们提出了一种条件流匹配模型，该模型通过仅在训练阶段进行的交叉拟合来估计单基因效应的可靠性，并利用这些估计对加性源分布进行校准。其速度场被分解为对加性参考分布的已知修正项与一个学习得到的残差传输场。在Norman基因扰动数据集上，对于由已观测单扰动构成的未见组合，平均绝对误差（MAE）从0.142降至0.131；当组成单扰动被留出时，MAE从0.198降至0.178。在留出的ComboSciPlex药物组合数据上，MAE从0.191降至0.176。非加性残差相关性从0.574提升至0.638，并且各组件的消融实验……
tldr: 提出ReliFlow——一种条件流匹配模型，通过训练期交叉拟合估计单基因效应可靠性并据此校准加性源分布，将速度场分解为加性参考的已知修正与学习得到的残差传输场，从而在单扰动证据稀疏或缺失的情况下显著提升组合扰动响应的预测精度。
en_tdlr: ReliFlow is a conditional flow-matching model that calibrates the additive source distribution using reliability estimates of single-gene effects obtained via training-only cross-fitting, decomposing the velocity into a known additive correction and a learned residual transport field, thereby substantially improving combinatorial perturbation prediction when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld.
